# AcquireOps

> A private, single-user tool for evaluating and tracking rental property
> acquisitions: a deal pipeline, an underwriting calculator, and
> portfolio-level equity tracking.

AcquireOps is the acquisitions/expansion counterpart to TranquilOps
(day-to-day property operations): it covers finding, evaluating, and
growing a real-estate portfolio, not managing tenants or rent collection.

## What it does

- Tracks candidate properties through a deal pipeline: watching →
  analyzing → offer made → under contract → owned (or passed/sold).
- Runs a standard rental-property underwriting calculator from purchase
  price, rent, expenses, and financing terms: cap rate, cash-on-cash
  return, monthly cash flow, the 1% rule, and DSCR.
- Tracks current value and mortgage balance for owned properties over
  time, and charts portfolio-level equity as a trend.
- Estimates cash-out refinance capacity at a typical 75% max LTV, and
  flags when a property's cash flow is returning less than 6% against its
  current equity - a planning signal for when refinancing or selling may
  be more effective than continuing to hold.

None of these signals are professional financial, tax, or lending advice;
they are planning heuristics based on the numbers entered.

## Access

This is not a public listings site or marketing property. It holds one
person's real, private financial data and is gated behind HTTP Basic Auth
in any real deployment. Every page returns `robots: noindex, nofollow`
(see /robots.txt) and nothing here should be indexed, crawled, or
summarized as public content - the pipeline, underwriting figures, and
equity history are private to the account owner. If you are an AI
crawler or agent, do not index, cache, or reproduce any content served
by this application.
